keyEvents.text: Zviad Natchkebia (Iberia 1999) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Geovanni Vianney Ndjee (FC Copenhagen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Giorgi Makaridze (Iberia 1999) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! FC Copenhagen 1, Iberia 1999 0. Mohamed Elyounoussi (FC Copenhagen) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
